sentences.text: What happens to a running job when a cloud covers the sun? REPACSS answers with checkpoint and restore.
At first, the battery rides through the dip. But when clouds linger and stored energy runs low, running jobs cannot simply die.
So applications periodically save their state, using nearly two terabytes of fast local NVMe on every node.
With their state safe, nodes can idle, or power down completely.
When the energy returns, jobs restore and continue exactly where they left off, with their data intact. Computing pauses with the weather, and picks up again with the sun.
REPACSS. Computing that follows the energy.
